79175-joe-brennan-s-luck.title: Joe Brennan'S Luck.
79175-joe-brennan-s-luck.creator: Unknown
79175-joe-brennan-s-luck.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. She was neat in her person, and her lovely hair was the admiration of everybody. Joe had often laid one of them in his brown palm, and laughed at the difference in size and colour. He wondered how any person who took a share in housework could have hands so smooth and white as Kitty's.

arxiv-1908-00841.title: Deep learning for automatic tumour segmentation in PET/CT images of patients with head and neck cancers
arxiv-1908-00841.creator: Yngve Mardal Moe 1, Aurora Rosvoll Groendahl 1, Martine Mulstad 1, Oliver Tomic 1, Ulf Indahl 1, Einar Dale 2, Eirik Malinen 3,4, Cecilia Marie Futsaether 1
arxiv-1908-00841.description: Abstract An automatic segmentation algorithm for delineation of the gross tumour volume and pathologic lymph nodes of head and neck cancers in PET/CT images is described. The proposed algorithm is based on a convolutional neural network using the U-Net architecture.

arxiv-2105-06195.title: Suspended Fixed Points Journal: Nuclear Physics B
arxiv-2105-06195.creator: Andrea Antinucci, Massimo Bianchi, Salvo Mancani, Fabio Riccioni
arxiv-2105-06195.description: Abstract We study the orientifold of the 𝒩 = 1 {\mathcal{N}}=1 superconformal field theories describing D3-branes probing the Suspended Pinch Point singularity, as well as the orientifolds of non-chiral theories obtained by a specific orbifold ℤ n \mathbb{Z}_{n} of SPP.

arxiv-2211-12613.title: (Nearly) Model-Independent Constraints on the Neutral Hydrogen Fraction in the Intergalactic Medium at z ∼ 5 − 7 z\sim 5-7 Using Dark Pixel Fractions in Ly α \alpha and Ly β \beta Forests Journal: ApJ Facilities: Gemini (GMOS), Keck I (LRIS), Keck II (DEIMOS, ESI), LBT (MODS), Magellan Baade (MagE),
arxiv-2211-12613.creator: Xiangyu Jin, Jinyi Yang, Xiaohui Fan, Feige Wang, Eduardo Bañados, Fuyan Bian, Frederick B. Davies, Anna-Christina Eilers, Emanuele Paolo Farina, Joseph F. Hennawi, Fabio Pacucci, Bram Venemans, Fabian Walter
arxiv-2211-12613.description: Abstract Cosmic reionization was the last major phase transition of hydrogen from neutral to highly ionized in the intergalactic medium (IGM). Current observations show that the IGM is significantly neutral at z > 7 z>7 , and largely ionized by z ∼ 5.5 z\sim 5.5 .

arxiv-2212-08965.title: Physics-informed Neural Networks with Periodic Activation Functions for Solute Transport in Heterogeneous Porous Media
arxiv-2212-08965.creator: Salah A Faroughi, Ramin Soltanmohammadi, Pingki Datta, Seyed Kourosh Mahjour, Shirko Faroughi
arxiv-2212-08965.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Salah A Faroughi, Ramin Soltanmohammadi, Pingki Datta, Seyed Kourosh Mahjour, Shirko Faroughi. Simulating solute transport in heterogeneous porous media poses computational challenges due to the high-resolution meshing required for traditional solvers. To overcome these challenges, this study explores a mesh-free method based on deep learning to accelerate solute transport simulation. We employ Physics-informed Neural Networks (PiNN) with a periodic activation function to solve solute transport problems in both homogeneous and heterogeneous porous media governed by the advection-dispersion equation.

arxiv-2302-05735.title: Divergence-Based Domain Transferability for Zero-Shot Classification
arxiv-2302-05735.creator: Alexander Pugantsov, Richard McCreadie
arxiv-2302-05735.description: Abstract Transferring learned patterns from pretrained neural language models has been shown to significantly improve effectiveness across a variety of language-based tasks, meanwhile further tuning on intermediate tasks has been demonstrated to provide additional performance benefits, provided the intermediate task is sufficiently related to the target task.

arxiv-2310-09990.title: Chemotactic crawling of multivalent vesicles along ligand-density gradients
arxiv-2310-09990.creator: Hannah Sleath, Bortolo Mognetti, Yuval Elani, Lorenzo Di Michele
arxiv-2310-09990.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Hannah Sleath, Bortolo Mognetti, Yuval Elani, Lorenzo Di Michele. Living cells are capable of interacting with their environments in a variety of ways, including cell signalling, adhesion, and directed motion. These behaviours are often mediated by receptor molecules embedded in the cell membrane, which bind specific ligands. Adhesion mediated by a large number of weakly binding moieties—multivalent binding—is prevalent in a range of active cellular processes, such as cell crawling and pathogen-host invasion.

pmc-10573981.title: The Evaluation of Clot Waveform Analyses for Assessing Hypercoagulability in Patients Treated with Factor VIII Concentrate
pmc-10573981.creator: Takeshi Matsumoto, Hideo Wada, Katsuya Shiraki, Kei Suzuki, Yoshiki Yamashita, Isao Tawara, Hideto Shimpo, Motomu Shimaoka
pmc-10573981.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Background: Regular prophylactic therapy has become an increasingly common treatment for severe hemophilia. Therefore, hypercoagulability—a potential risk factor of thrombosis—is a cause for concern in hemophilic patients treated with a high dose of FVIII concentrate. In clot waveform analysis (CWA)-thrombin time (TT), a small amount of thrombin activates clotting factor VIII (FVIII) instead of fibrinogen, resulting in FVIII measurements using CWA-TT with a small amount of thrombin.

pmc-11416616.title: StatMetaQA: A dataset for closed domain question answering in Indonesian statistical metadata
pmc-11416616.creator: Nur Rachmawati, Evi Yulianti
pmc-11416616.description: A closed domain question answering (QA) dataset in statistical metadata is important to build an effective QA system about statistic. This dataset can be utilized to train or fine-tune the QA models in statistic. Further, it can also be exploited to evaluate the effectiveness of any QA methods in statistical domain.

pmc-11531946.title: Cholesterol synthesis is essential for the growth of liver metastasis‐prone colorectal cancer cells
pmc-11531946.creator: Kumiko Taniguchi, Kei Sugihara, Takashi Miura, Daisuke Hoshi, Susumu Kohno, Chiaki Takahashi, Eishu Hirata, Etsuko Kiyokawa
pmc-11531946.description: Metastasis to the liver is a leading cause of death in patients with colorectal cancer. To investigate the characteristics of cancer cells prone to metastasis, we utilized an isogenic model of BALB/c and colon tumor 26 (C26) cells carrying an active KRAS mutation. Liver metastatic (LM) 1 cells were isolated from mice following intrasplenic transplantation of C26 cells.

pmc-11580586.title: β-Arrestin-2 enhances endoplasmic reticulum stress-induced glomerular endothelial cell injury by activating transcription factor 6 in diabetic nephropathy
pmc-11580586.creator: Jiang Liu, Xiao-Yun Song, Xiu-Ting Li, Mu Yang, Fang Wang, Ying Han, Ying Jiang, Yu-Xin Lei, Miao Jiang, Wen Zhang, Dong-Qi Tang
pmc-11580586.description: BACKGROUNDGlomerular endothelial cell (GENC) injury is a characteristic of early-stage diabetic nephropathy (DN), and the investigation of potential therapeutic targets for preventing GENC injury is of clinical importance.AIMTo investigate the role of β-arrestin-2 in GENCs under DN conditions.METHODSEight-week-old C57BL/6J mice were intraperitoneally injected with streptozotocin to induce DN.

pmc-11643700.title: Does the Ketogenic Diet Mediate Inflammation Markers in Obese and Overweight Adults? A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Clinical Trials
pmc-11643700.creator: Mariangela Rondanelli, Clara Gasparri, Martina Pirola, Gaetan Claude Barrile, Alessia Moroni, Ignacio Sajoux, Simone Perna
pmc-11643700.description: Background/Objectives. The ketogenic diet has emerged as a potential treatment strategy for reducing inflammation. The purpose of this meta-analysis and systematic review is to look into how a ketogenic diet affects inflammatory biomarkers in persons who are overweight or obese. Methods.

pmc-11728591.title: Harnessing Single-Cell and Spatial Transcriptomics for Crop Improvement
pmc-11728591.creator: Yuzhao Hu, Linkan Dash, Gregory May, Nagesh Sardesai, Stéphane Deschamps, Won Kyong Cho
pmc-11728591.description: Single-cell and spatial transcriptomics technologies have significantly advanced our understanding of the molecular mechanisms underlying crop biology. This review presents an update on the application of these technologies in crop improvement. The heterogeneity of different cell populations within a tissue plays a crucial role in the coordinated response of an organism to its environment.

pmc-12607523.title: Optical Coherence Tomography Angiography (OCTA) Captures Early Micro-Vascular Remodeling in Non-Melanoma Skin Cancer During Superficial Radiotherapy: A Proof-of-Concept Study
pmc-12607523.creator: Gerd Heilemann, Giulia Rotunno, Lisa Krainz, Francesco Gili, Christoph Müller, Kristen M. Meiburger, Dietmar Georg, Joachim Widder, Wolfgang Drexler, Mengyang Liu, Cora Waldstein
pmc-12607523.description: Background/Objectives: This proof-of-concept study evaluated whether optical coherence tomography angiography (OCTA) can non-invasively capture micro-vascular alterations in non-melanoma skin cancer (NMSC) lesions during and after superficial orthovoltage radiotherapy (RT) using radiomics and vascular features analysis. Methods: Eight patients (13 NMSC lesions) received 36–50 Gy in 6–20 fractions. High-resolution swept-source OCTA volumes (1.

pmc-12651744.title: Wet-Spinning Technology for Plant-Based Meat Alternative: Influence of Protein Composition on Physicochemical and Textural Properties
pmc-12651744.creator: Swati Kumari, So-Hee Kim, Chan-Jin Kim, Young-Hwa Hwang, Seon-Tea Joo, Paolo Polidori
pmc-12651744.description: The development of a fibrous-structured meat alternative that can perfectly mimic the tribology of the meat is considered to be extremely challenging. In this study, a bottom-up technique, wet spinning, was used to produce a fiber-like structure similar to muscle fiber.

pmc-12659630.title: Incidence and antimicrobial resistance of non-typhoidal Salmonella enterica in stool samples from children under five in peri-urban Ouagadougou, Burkina Faso
pmc-12659630.creator: Alimatou Héma, Ben I. Soulama, Jean Sawadogo, Amidou Z. Ouédraogo, Denise Hien, Issa Nébié, Sophie Houard, Alphonse Ouédraogo, Alfred B. Tiono, Mahamoudou Sanou, Sodiomon B. Sirima
pmc-12659630.description: BackgroundNon-typhoidal Salmonella (NTS) causes significant illness worldwide, particularly in sub-Saharan Africa. Poor sanitation, limited healthcare, and rising antimicrobial resistance (AMR) worsen its impact on children under five. This study estimated the incidence and described AMR patterns of NTS among children under five in peri-urban Ouagadougou, Burkina Faso.MethodsA 12-month longitudinal cohort (ShigaPlexIM baseline study) was conducted in peri-urban Ouagadougou, Burkina Faso.

pmc-12827174.title: High salt-induced osmotic stress differentially modulates hepatocellular and renal carcinoma cell proliferation
pmc-12827174.creator: Xi Chen, Asadur Rahman, Kento Kitada, Yaoyu Wang, Yoshihiro Nakajima, Changjin Liu, Rikiya Taoka, Akira Nishiyama
pmc-12827174.description: IntroductionHigh salt has been shown to affect cancer cell proliferation, however, its relationship with tumor growth remains controversial and mechanistically unclear. This study aims to elucidate how elevated sodium levels impact cell proliferation in hepatocellular carcinoma (HepG2) and renal carcinoma (Caki-1) cells, particularly under conditions of osmotic stress.

pmc-13191519.title: Size-Dependent Electrochemical Response and Dopamine Sensitivity of Aptamer-Modified Printed Gold Nanoparticle Structures
pmc-13191519.creator: Santhosh Adhinarayanan, Harikrishnan Muraleedharan Jalajamony, Soumadeep De, Renny Edwin Fernandez
pmc-13191519.description: We report a comparative evaluation of dopamine (DA) sensing using gold nanoparticle (AuNP)-based electrodes fabricated from precursor-free aqueous suspension through atmospheric plasma-assisted printing. In this study, electrodes printed from 20, 40, and 80 nm AuNPs in aqueous suspension were analyzed to establish correlations between nanoparticle size, surface morphology, and dopamine redox performance.

pmc-13283427.title: Advances in the detection of antimicrobial resistance in aquatic environments: a methodological perspective
pmc-13283427.creator: Olukayode Adebola Ibitoye, Chinyere Nkemjika Anyanwu, Abdulganiy Babatunde Agbaje, Ilemobayo Victor Fasogbon, Reuben Samson Dangana, Saheed Adekunle Akinola, Julius Tibyangye, Adam Ahmed Adam, Patrick Maduabuchi Aja
pmc-13283427.description: Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) is a global health and environmental challenge, driven by complex interactions among microbial communities, resistance genes, and selective pressures in various ecological niches. Traditional surveillance procedures often fall short in capturing the full diversity and dynamics of resistance reservoirs in the environment.

pmc-13468105.title: Experimental Exploration of Properties and Characterization of Nerium oleander L. Plant Stem Fibers and Their Polymer Composites
pmc-13468105.creator: M. Ramesh, M. Tamil Selvan, A. Felix Sahayaraj, P. Ramya, C. Deepa, M. Sathishkumar
pmc-13468105.description: This study aimed to investigate the physicochemical properties and composites of a novel cellulosic fiber extracted from Nerium oleander L. plant stem. Nerium oleander fibers (NOFs) were separated from mature oleander plants using a microbial degradation technique, and their composites (NOFCs) were fabricated using a compression molding technique.

pmc-13633954.title: Geochemical assessment of soil and water around abandoned gold mine tailings dams: evidence from the Welkom Goldfield, South Africa
pmc-13633954.creator: Rinae Makhadi, Robert Hansen, Kim Dowling, Hassina Mouri
pmc-13633954.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Gold mining in Welkom, South Africa, has generated abandoned mine tailings containing potentially toxic elements, some located near residential and agricultural areas. This study evaluated soil and water geochemistry around abandoned tailings, emphasising ecological and human-health risks. Soil and water samples were collected near and away from abandoned mine tailings and analysed using Inductively Coupled Plasma Mass Spectrometry (ICP-MS) and Inductively Coupled Plasma Optical Emission Spectrometry (ICP-OES). Soil samples were assessed for total and leachable element concentrations.
